_about: Every exclusion site in scripts/ (a named EXCLUDE/EXCLUSION/SKIP/IGNORE/EXEMPT constant, or a quoted ':!' / ':(exclude)' git pathspec) with the reason it exists. Derived and enforced by scripts/check-gate-census.mjs: a site with no entry fails, an entry whose site is gone fails. 'finding' marks an exclusion that hides in-scope content and is filed, not yet fixed (plan row 61: the three filed findings were fixed 2026-10-08, so none remains).

The reader probe looks for CODE that reads a variable; markdown is the documentation being checked, so a doc naming the variable must not count as its reader.
Same reason as ':!*.md' for the non-markdown files under docs/: documentation cannot be the reader that proves a documented variable is live.
The gate's own regexes and fixtures spell process.env.SIGNALGRID_* shapes; counting itself would make every documented variable look read.
Skips build output, coverage, third_party and __fixtures__; fixtures deliberately hold divergent freshness bodies and are not product code.
Two npm scripts that are not gates (verify:ledger-export is an operator CLI, test:stress a diagnostic with no threshold); each carries its reason in the map.

Skips build output, coverage, .git and .claude/worktrees — other agents' checkouts reached only because the walk reads the filesystem, not the index.
adapters/emit-gate.ts IS the emission gate, so its fetch is the boundary itself rather than a connector reaching a vendor around it.
The boundary's own rule file and the gate running it must contain the forbidden shapes as controls (publication boundary, not edited here).

Named mutation-sweep cells where an ABSENT signal (a tenant with no such connector) legitimately does not tighten the verdict, because no tenant-level expectation of a signal category is modelled; each entry names its exact cells and carries its own reason, and a loosening on any other cell still fails.

Known scratch and generated paths (virtualenvs, caches, node_modules, dist, build, .DS_Store) do not change which MCP code ran, so they do not mark live evidence dirty. Lockfiles are NOT scratch: an untracked uv.lock or poetry.lock changes resolved dependencies and counts as source (plan row 61; scripts/check-untracked-ignore.mjs --self-test).

Not an exclusion of the subject but the opposite: the regex names the two warnings `git for-each-ref` prints when it silently SKIPS a ref it cannot read, so that a listing carrying either is treated as a hard failure (an unreadable ref is an unknown, and unknown is not clean) instead of a shorter list that reads as complete.
